description.p: Discover movies and shows, save favorites and Watch from your own library
Kovelyx est une application de gestion de médiathèque, conçue pour Windows, Android et Android TV.
Discover titles, build your own library, track progress, and keep your watch history in sync with Trakt in a clean interface designed for large screens.
